content.title: Identity-Locked Travel Chapters | Landmark Relay, Tactile Proof, Destination Close
content.summary: A textile researcher crosses a river city through material and food touchpoints. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity, wardrobe and carried anchor persist. + Locations form a plausible route rather than random tourism cuts. + Each chapter includes one visible local interaction. + Day and night changes do not reset identity. + The destination overview closes the route and title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult textile researcher in a cobalt coat from an original river-city night overlook. Let her touch one woven sample and taste one local pear slice as two bounded place proofs. End at a hill observatory with the exact original title RIVER CITY / ONE DAY.
required_anchors: One adult identity, wardrobe and carried anchor persist.
Locations form a plausible route rather than random tourism cuts.
Day and night changes do not reset identity.
The destination overview closes the route and title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A textile researcher crosses a river city through material and food touchpoints. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
